title: AMD21-ASMR-IMPL — Six-vector memory extraction in observer-agent.ts

changes.description: Added ASMRVector interface (6 fields: semantic_core, emotional_valence, temporal_context, causal_chain, agent_signature, confidence_score + metadata). Added extractASMRVector() and writeASMRVectors() functions. Wired into cycle() — ASMR vectors written to logs/asmr/YYYY-MM-DD.jsonl after each AAR batch.
